description_en: Creates a rate limiting rule to throttle traffic from specified source CIDR blocks
description_zh: 调用CreateNatRateLimitRule接口创建限速规则, 可以对指定源IP地址段做限速
name: CreateNatRateLimitRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
NAT 网关所在的地域 ID。

您可以通过调用 DescribeRegions 接口获取地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway to which the rate limiting rule belongs
parameters.help_zh: 限速规则所属 NAT 网关所在的地域 ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the rate limiting rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the rate limiting rule
parameters.name: rule_description

parameters.help_en: The list of source CIDR blocks to which the rate limiting rule applies
parameters.name: source_cidrs

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: The system prechecks the request without creating the rate limiting rule. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, and validates the request format and limits. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.


false (default): The system sends a normal request. If the request passes the precheck, the rate limiting rule is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建限速规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。


false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建限速规则
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The source match type for rate limiting. Valid values:

CIDR: CIDR block match. This is the default value.
TUNNEL: tunnel match. If you set the value to TUNNEL, a corresponding SNAT rule of the TUNNEL type must exist
parameters.help_zh:
限速 源匹配类型，取值

CIDR：网段匹配（默认值）
TUNNEL：隧道匹配 当取值为 TUNNEL 时，需要有对应的TUNNEL类型的SNAT规则存在
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The tunnel index. If MatchType is set to TUNNEL, a corresponding SNAT rule must exist
parameters.help_zh: 隧道索引，当 MatchType 为 TUNNEL 时，需要有对应的SNAT规则存在
parameters.name: tunnel_index

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the rate limiting rule
